hero.name: Sk. Roushan Khalid
hero.philosophy: "Building intelligent systems that combine machine learning research with scalable software engineering."

about.lead: I am an AI/ML Engineer building intelligent systems that combine machine learning research with scalable software engineering.
paragraphs: I enjoy building AI systems that solve real-world problems—from classical machine learning and deep learning to modern LLM-powered applications.
My work focuses on designing reliable AI pipelines, developing scalable backend services, and transforming research ideas into production-ready software.
I enjoy working across the complete AI lifecycle—from experimentation and model development to backend architecture, deployment, and production systems—while continuously learning by building.

skills.title: Artificial Intelligence
skills.description: Building machine learning, deep learning, computer vision, and generative AI systems—from experimentation and model training to deployment and production integration.

skills.title: LLM & Generative AI
skills.description: Developing production-ready LLM applications including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, orchestration workflows, and vector search systems.

skills.title: Backend Engineering & Infrastructure
skills.description: Designing scalable backend services, REST APIs, cloud-native deployments, databases, and containerized applications for AI systems.

timeline.title: AI Engineer · Kamal-Paterson Ltd / KPCloud
timeline.description: Building AI-powered applications and production backend systems for agritech. Designing FastAPI services, LLM-powered workflows, offline-first Flutter applications, React dashboards, PostgreSQL databases, and cloud-native deployments using Docker on AWS.

timeline.title: Research Intern · Learnix Research Lab
timeline.description: Conducting applied machine learning research focused on bridging academic methodologies with production-ready AI systems. Exploring practical ML foundations, scalable implementations, and engineering best practices.

timeline.title: B.Sc. Software Engineering · Daffodil International University
timeline.description: Graduated with a CGPA of 3.65/4.00 with a major in Data Science. Built strong foundations in software engineering, artificial intelligence, machine learning, algorithms, databases, and distributed systems while actively participating in technical communities and research initiatives.

approach.title: Engineering Beyond Models
approach.description: Good AI products require more than accurate models. They require thoughtful engineering, reliable systems, and a deep understanding of the problems they're solving.

approach.title: Production-First Mindset
approach.description: I enjoy taking ideas from experimentation to production by building scalable backend services, maintainable APIs, and robust AI pipelines that can be deployed with confidence.

approach.title: Build, Learn & Iterate
approach.description: The fastest way to grow is by designing, shipping, and continuously improving real systems. Every project is an opportunity to deepen both engineering and AI expertise.

approach.title: Real-World Impact over Hype
approach.description: AI is only valuable when it solves real problems for real people. I'm not chasing trends — I'm interested in what actually works.

contributions.title: Backend Systems for AI Products
contributions.description: Designing and building the API and backend layer that AI features run on — from relational database schemas to FastAPI endpoints to containerized service setups on AWS.

contributions.title: LLM Integration & RAG Pipelines
contributions.description: Building RAG systems from scratch — document ingestion, vector retrieval with FAISS, prompt engineering, and connecting them to production APIs with real user-facing interfaces.

contributions.title: Data Handling & Geospatial Workflows
contributions.description: Structuring data flows, building intelligent automation pipelines, and integrating external data sources (weather APIs, geospatial GIS data, time-series) into AI systems.

contributions.title: AI Feature Development & Prototyping
contributions.description: Prototyping, evaluating models, iterating on system behavior, and translating research concepts into working, production-ready implementations.
